title: Minimal Diagnostics request with compact subfunction body
purpose: Increase real function coverage with a compact Diagnostics-style request that reaches a different parser path than the read operations while remaining fully framed and mutation-friendly.

messages.label: diagnostics request with subfunction and data

expected_behavior: The target should parse one valid Diagnostics request and either return a function-specific response or a bounded exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 08 is accompanied by two-byte subfunction and two-byte data fields
No undeclared trailing bytes are present
issue_safety_notes: This seed broadens parser coverage using a conservative minimal body. It is not derived from an exact issue PoC and does not attempt to reproduce any out-of-bounds condition.
